observations: After a real known or unknown move receipt, the complete 'So I'd like to cancel my old appointment, please' reached an owned final transcript but triggered classifier HTTP (3 to 4 requests).

After a known move, 'Please cancel my original appointment' bypassed the classifier but replied generically: Your appointment move is confirmed. I haven't made another change. Please contact the clinic to review it before trying another change.
Confirmed booking cancellation, don't-book and email-proof follow-ups and both unsent controls reported no assertion failures. No second mutation or false cancellation was observed.
The earlier incorrect move-slot fixture expectation is retained and qualified separately.
